# Understanding wages
In Victoria, payroll tax is based on what counts as wages.

## Wage components
- [superannuation contributions](https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/payroll-tax/wages/victorian-wages/superannuation), including [salary sacrifice](https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/payroll-tax/wages/victorian-wages/salary-sacrifice-arrangements)

## Declare all taxable wages
This ensures the correct amount of payroll tax is paid.

Updated: 22 October 2026

# Payroll tax (current rates) ## Payroll tax rates from 1 July 2025 onward | Period | Maximum deduction | Rate | |-|-|-| | From 1 July 2025 onward | $1,000,000 | $83,333 | 4.85%
1.2125% for [regional Victorian employers](https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/payroll-tax/industries-and-locations/regional-employers) | ### Phase-out rate From 1 July 2024, employers and groups with total annual taxable Australian wages between $3,000,000 and $5,000,000 are eligible for a reduced deduction, where the deduction is subject to a degree of phasing out. Employers and groups with total annual taxable Australian wages above $5,000,000 are not eligible for any deduction. ### Payroll tax surcharges Two surcharges apply if you pay Victorian taxable wages and your Australian wages exceed the first annual threshold of $10 million, with a first monthly threshold of $833,333.

web.title: Superannuation - State Revenue Office
web.description:
# Superannuation
Superannuation contribution payments count as wages.

## Types of superannuation contributions
The taxable value will be the agreed value or the value attributed to the contribution, whichever is greater.

## Employees, directors and contractors
Employers must pay payroll tax on superannuation contributions for:

## Payroll tax change 1997
Employer superannuation contributions are taxable if they relate to work done on or after that date.

Regular contributions and top-up contributions to these funds are taxable if they relate to work done on or after 1 July 1997.

web.title: Does Payroll Tax Include Superannuation
web.description: Yes, payroll tax includes superannuation. However, only the superannuation contributions made by the employer will be considered for payroll tax.
